using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

namespace Axm.Rodoh.Action.Editor
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductProfile
    {
        public string format;
        public string productId;
        public string experienceId;
        public string challengeId;
        public string timingProfileId;
        public string scenePath;
        public string presentationAdapterId;
        public string controlAdapterId;
        public string mode;
        public string[] requiredDevices;
        public ActionPlayerProductIdentityPolicy productIdentity;
        public ActionPlayerProductPresentationPolicy presentation;
        public ActionPlayerProductControlPolicy controls;
        public ActionPlayerProductPerformancePolicy performance;
        public ActionPlayerProductAcceptancePolicy acceptance;
        public ActionPlayerProductSoftwareAcceptancePolicy softwareAcceptance;
        public ActionPlayerProductPhysicalAcceptancePolicy physicalAcceptance;
        public ActionPlayerProductAccessibilityPolicy accessibility;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductIdentityPolicy
    {
        public bool serializedOnPlayerRoot;
        public bool requiredAtRuntime;
        public bool requiredForBuild;
        public bool requiredForPhysicalSession;
        public bool worldCommitExact;
        public bool arcCommitExact;
        public bool profileDigestExact;
        public bool sceneDigestExact;
        public bool actionSpecDigestExact;
        public bool arcDigestExact;
        public bool presentationManifestIdExact;
        public bool sceneJobDigestExact;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductPresentationPolicy
    {
        public bool primitiveFallbackAllowed;
        public bool diagnosticPresentationAllowed;
        public int minimumProductionAssetCount;
        public bool allFiveEnemyKitsRequired;
        public bool arenaPrefabRequired;
        public bool semanticCueFeedbackRequired;
        public int minimumSemanticCueCount;
        public bool cameraCollisionRequired;
        public bool runtimeRebindingRequired;
        public bool activeUnityPhysicsAuthorityAllowed;
        public bool assetProvenanceRequired;
        public bool namedRepresentationApprovalRequired;
        public string representationApprovalReceiptFormat;
        public bool approvalMustBindCompleteDependencyClosure;
        public bool approvalMustBindPrefabAndMetaCustody;
        public bool approvalMustBindDeclaredBindingClosure;
        public int minimumDeclaredBindingCount;
        public int minimumUniqueDeclaredAssetCount;
        public string representationIntakeReceiptFormat;
        public string representationAuditReceiptFormat;
        public bool readOnlyIntakeRequired;
        public bool readOnlyPostSerializationAuditRequired;
        public bool finalAcceptorMustDifferFromRepresentationApprover;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductControlPolicy
    {
        public bool keyboardMouseRequired;
        public bool gamepadRequired;
        public bool runtimeRebindingRequired;
        public bool gamepadRebindMustChangeProfileDigest;
        public bool oneHandedMappings;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductPerformancePolicy
    {
        public int targetFps;
        public float maximumP95FrameMilliseconds;
        public float maximumP99FrameMilliseconds;
        public int minimumMeasuredFrames;
        public bool perDeviceReceiptRequired;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductAcceptancePolicy
    {
        public bool fullTeachPracticeMasterRequired;
        public bool allRequiredCuesObserved;
        public bool cameraCollisionObserved;
        public bool bindingProfileRecorded;
        public string candidateAuthority;
        public bool arcReplayRequired;
        public bool roleSeparatedColdSeatsRequired;
        public bool coldPlayerObserverAdjudicatorMustDiffer;
        public bool coldPlayerObserverAdjudicatorLineagesMustDiffer;
        public bool coldPlayerObserverAdjudicatorContextsMustDiffer;
        public bool sourceIsolationRequired;
        public bool immutableObservationPacketRequired;
        public bool runtimeMayIssueComprehensionReceipt;
        public bool candidateAuthorMayIssueComprehensionReceipt;
        public bool coldSeatReceiptMayClaimHumanEvidence;
        public bool humanRequiredForWindowsSoftwareAcceptance;
        public bool physicalHumanEvidenceSeparate;
        public bool finalSoftwareAcceptorSeatMustDiffer;
        public bool finalSoftwareAcceptorLineageMustDiffer;
        public bool finalSoftwareAcceptorContextMustDiffer;
        public bool finalAcceptorMayModifyArtifact;
        public bool voluntaryContinuationAfterConsequenceRequired;
        public bool namedPlayerProductAcceptanceRequired;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductSoftwareAcceptancePolicy
    {
        public string comprehensionMode;
        public string comprehensionReceiptFormat;
        public bool humanRequired;
        public bool runtimeMayIssueReceipt;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductPhysicalAcceptancePolicy
    {
        public string humanPlayEvidence;
        public string householdInstallationEvidence;
        public string questEvidence;
        public bool coldSeatMayClaimHumanEvidence;
        public bool requiredForWindowsSoftwareAcceptance;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductAccessibilityPolicy
    {
        public bool reducedMotionSupported;
        public bool highContrastSupported;
        public bool audioOptional;
        public bool hapticsOptional;
        public bool oneHandedMappings;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductAssetReceipt
    {
        public string assetId;
        public string prefabPath;
        public string prefabSha256;
        public string sourcePath;
        public string sourceSha256;
        public bool approved;
        public string approvalId;
        public string approvalAuthorityId;
        public string approvalName;
        public string approvalAttestation;
        public string approvedAt;
        public bool generatedPrimitive;
        public bool activePhysicsAuthority;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActionPlayerProductReceipt
    {
        public string format;
        public string generatedAt;
        public string status;
        public string productId;
        public string productProfileSha256;
        public string worldCommit;
        public string arcCommit;
        public string unityVersion;
        public string challengeId;
        public string timingProfileId;
        public string actionSpecDigest;
        public string arcDigest;
        public string presentationManifestId;
        public string presentationManifestSha256;
        public string scenePath;
        public string sceneSha256;
        public string sceneJobDigest;
        public string presentationAdapterId;
        public bool diagnosticPresentation;
        public bool primitiveFallback;
        public bool activePhysicsAuthority;
        public string playerAssetId;
        public string arenaAssetId;
        public string[] enemyAssetIds;
        public string[] productionAssetIds;
        public ActionPlayerProductAssetReceipt[] assets;
        public bool exactCueCoverage;
        public bool semanticCueFeedback;
        public bool cameraCollision;
        public int arenaCollisionSurfaces;
        public bool keyboardMouse;
        public bool gamepad;
        public bool runtimeRebinding;
        public string bindingProfileDigest;
        public bool playerSessionEvidence;
        public bool performanceRecorder;
        public bool buildEligible;
        public string independentComprehension;
        public string coldSeatComprehension;
        public string physicalHumanEvidence;
        public string humanEvidence;
        public string productAcceptance;
        public string error;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Exact serialized player-product gate. This is stronger than source
    /// conformance and weaker than a built-player, device, cold-seat comprehension,
    /// physical-human, or final product-acceptance receipt.
    /// </summary>
    public static class ActionPlayerProductBatch
    {
        private const string ReceiptFormat = "rodoh-action-player-product-qualification/1";
        private const string SceneJobFormat = "rodoh-action-scene-job/1";
        private const string ProductProfileFormat = "rodoh-action-player-product-profile/1";

        public static void Run()
        {
            var outputRoot = GetRequiredArgument("-outputRoot");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(outputRoot);
            var receiptPath = Path.Combine(outputRoot, "player-product-qualification.json");
            var receipt = new ActionPlayerProductReceipt
            {
                format = ReceiptFormat,
                generatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o"),
                status = "fail",
                independentComprehension = "open",
                coldSeatComprehension = "open",
                physicalHumanEvidence = "separate-open",
                humanEvidence = "separate-open",
                productAcceptance = "not-issued",
            };

            try
            {
                var scenePath = NormalizeAssetPath(GetRequiredArgument("-scenePath"));
                var sceneJobPath = GetRequiredArgument("-sceneJob");
                var presentationPath = GetRequiredArgument("-presentation");
                var productProfilePath = GetRequiredArgument("-productProfile");
                var worldCommit = GetRequiredArgument("-worldCommit");
                var arcCommit = GetRequiredArgument("-arcCommit");
                RequireHexCommit(worldCommit, "World commit");
                RequireHexCommit(arcCommit, "Arc commit");

                var sceneJob = JsonUtility.FromJson<ActionSceneJob>(File.ReadAllText(sceneJobPath));
                var manifest = JsonUtility.FromJson<ActionPresentationManifest>(File.ReadAllText(presentationPath));
                var profileText = File.ReadAllText(productProfilePath);
                var profile = JsonUtility.FromJson<ActionPlayerProductProfile>(profileText);
                ValidateSourceContracts(sceneJob, manifest, profile, worldCommit, arcCommit);

                if (!File.Exists(ToProjectFile(scenePath))) throw new InvalidOperationException("Serialized player scene is absent: " + scenePath);
                var scene = EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(scenePath, OpenSceneMode.Single);
                var runtime = FindSingle<ActionRuntimeBehaviour>();
                var presentation = FindSingle<ActionProductionPresentation>();
                var input = FindSingle<ActionNaturalPlayerInput>();
                var bindings = FindSingle<ActionInputBindings>();
                var identity = FindSingle<ActionPlayerProductIdentity>();
                var collision = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<ActionCameraCollision>(true);
                var sessionEvidence = FindSingle<ActionPlayerSessionEvidence>();
                var performance = FindSingle<ActionPerformanceRecorder>();
                var spec = runtime.Spec;
                if (spec == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Serialized player scene has no action spec.");
                if (spec.ActionSpecDigest != sceneJob.actionSpecDigest || spec.ArcDigest != sceneJob.arcDigest) throw new InvalidOperationException("Serialized scene lost action or Arc identity.");
                if (spec.TimingProfileId != profile.timingProfileId) throw new InvalidOperationException("Serialized scene lost timing-profile custody.");
                if (presentation.AdapterId != profile.presentationAdapterId || presentation.DiagnosticOnly) throw new InvalidOperationException("Serialized scene is not using the required production presentation adapter.");
                if (input.AdapterId != profile.controlAdapterId) throw new InvalidOperationException("Serialized scene is not using the required natural input adapter.");
                if (presentation.UsesUnityPhysicsAuthority() != profile.presentation.activeUnityPhysicsAuthorityAllowed) throw new InvalidOperationException("Serialized presentation crossed the deterministic physics-authority boundary.");

                var profileSha = Sha256String(profileText);
                var sceneSha = Sha256File(ToProjectFile(scenePath));
                var sceneJobSha = Sha256File(sceneJobPath);
                identity.Configure(
                    profile.productId,
                    profileSha,
                    worldCommit,
                    arcCommit,
                    spec.ActionSpecDigest,
                    spec.ArcDigest,
                    manifest.manifestId,
                    scenePath,
                    sceneSha,
                    sceneJobSha,
                    "source-and-scene-qualified");
                var productIdentity = identity.Identity;
                if (!identity.IsConfigured || productIdentity.productId != profile.productId) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product identity did not serialize onto the player root.");
                if (productIdentity.worldCommit != worldCommit || productIdentity.arcCommit != arcCommit) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product identity lost exact source commits.");
                if (productIdentity.actionSpecDigest != spec.ActionSpecDigest || productIdentity.arcDigest != spec.ArcDigest) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product identity lost exact Arc action law.");
                if (productIdentity.sceneSha256 != sceneSha || productIdentity.sceneJobDigest != sceneJobSha) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product identity lost serialized scene custody.");
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(productIdentity.BindingDigest)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product identity binding digest is absent.");

                var assetReceipts = CollectProductionAssets(profile, manifest, presentation);
                var productionIds = assetReceipts.Select(asset => asset.assetId).OrderBy(value => value, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
                if (productionIds.Length < profile.presentation.minimumProductionAssetCount) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product lacks the required production-asset floor.");
                var enemyIds = assetReceipts.Where(asset => asset.assetId.StartsWith("enemy:", StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(asset => asset.assetId).OrderBy(value => value, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
                if (profile.presentation.allFiveEnemyKitsRequired && enemyIds.Length != 5) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product does not bind all five enemy kits.");
                var playerAsset = assetReceipts.Single(asset => asset.assetId == "player:rhea-venn");
                var arenaAsset = assetReceipts.Single(asset => asset.assetId == "arena:pump-seven");
                var cueIds = spec.SemanticCues.Select(cue => cue.cueId).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
                var cueCoverage = cueIds.Length >= profile.presentation.minimumSemanticCueCount && cueIds.All(presentation.SupportsCue);
                if (profile.presentation.semanticCueFeedbackRequired && !cueCoverage) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product does not cover every required semantic cue.");
                var arenaCollision = CountArenaCollisionSurfaces(manifest.arena.recipe);
                if (profile.presentation.cameraCollisionRequired && (collision.Length == 0 || arenaCollision == 0)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product lacks dynamic camera collision over an authored arena surface.");
                if (profile.presentation.runtimeRebindingRequired && !bindings.RuntimeRebinding) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product lacks runtime rebinding.");
                if (profile.controls.gamepadRebindMustChangeProfileDigest && !bindings.RuntimeRebinding) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product cannot produce a persisted rebind profile.");
                if (!sessionEvidence.enabled) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product session evidence is disabled.");
                if (!performance.enabled) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product performance recorder is disabled.");
                if (profile.softwareAcceptance == null || profile.softwareAcceptance.comprehensionMode != "role-separated-cold-seat" || profile.softwareAcceptance.comprehensionReceiptFormat != "rodoh-underdrain-cold-seat-comprehension/1") throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product does not declare the role-separated cold-seat software-comprehension contract.");
                if (profile.softwareAcceptance.humanRequired || profile.softwareAcceptance.runtimeMayIssueReceipt) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product incorrectly makes human staffing or runtime self-certification a Windows software gate.");
                if (profile.physicalAcceptance == null || profile.physicalAcceptance.requiredForWindowsSoftwareAcceptance || profile.physicalAcceptance.coldSeatMayClaimHumanEvidence) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product collapsed physical human evidence into cold-seat software acceptance.");

                receipt.status = "pass";
                receipt.productId = profile.productId;
                receipt.productProfileSha256 = profileSha;
                receipt.worldCommit = worldCommit;
                receipt.arcCommit = arcCommit;
                receipt.unityVersion = Application.unityVersion;
                receipt.challengeId = spec.ChallengeId;
                receipt.timingProfileId = spec.TimingProfileId;
                receipt.actionSpecDigest = spec.ActionSpecDigest;
                receipt.arcDigest = spec.ArcDigest;
                receipt.presentationManifestId = manifest.manifestId;
                receipt.presentationManifestSha256 = Sha256File(presentationPath);
                receipt.scenePath = scenePath;
                receipt.sceneSha256 = sceneSha;
                receipt.sceneJobDigest = sceneJobSha;
                receipt.presentationAdapterId = presentation.AdapterId;
                receipt.diagnosticPresentation = presentation.DiagnosticOnly;
                receipt.primitiveFallback = assetReceipts.Any(asset => asset.generatedPrimitive);
                receipt.activePhysicsAuthority = presentation.UsesUnityPhysicsAuthority();
                receipt.playerAssetId = playerAsset.assetId;
                receipt.arenaAssetId = arenaAsset.assetId;
                receipt.enemyAssetIds = enemyIds;
                receipt.productionAssetIds = productionIds;
                receipt.assets = assetReceipts;
                receipt.exactCueCoverage = cueCoverage;
                receipt.semanticCueFeedback = profile.presentation.semanticCueFeedbackRequired;
                receipt.cameraCollision = collision.Length > 0;
                receipt.arenaCollisionSurfaces = arenaCollision;
                receipt.keyboardMouse = profile.controls.keyboardMouseRequired;
                receipt.gamepad = profile.controls.gamepadRequired;
                receipt.runtimeRebinding = bindings.RuntimeRebinding;
                receipt.bindingProfileDigest = bindings.BindingProfileDigest;
                receipt.playerSessionEvidence = sessionEvidence.enabled;
                receipt.performanceRecorder = performance.enabled;
                receipt.buildEligible = true;

                EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(scene);
                EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(scene);
                AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                receipt.error = ex.ToString();
                WriteReceipt(receiptPath, receipt);
                Debug.LogException(ex);
                UnityEditor.EditorApplication.Exit(1);
                return;
            }

            WriteReceipt(receiptPath, receipt);
            UnityEditor.EditorApplication.Exit(0);
        }

        private static void ValidateSourceContracts(ActionSceneJob job, ActionPresentationManifest manifest, ActionPlayerProductProfile profile, string worldCommit, string arcCommit)
        {
            if (job == null || job.format != SceneJobFormat) throw new InvalidOperationException("Action scene job format is unsupported.");
            if (manifest == null || manifest.format != ActionPresentationManifest.Format) throw new InvalidOperationException("Authored presentation manifest format is unsupported.");
            if (profile == null || profile.format != ProductProfileFormat) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product profile format is unsupported.");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.productId)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product id is absent.");
            if (profile.challengeId != "breach-crown-pump" || profile.timingProfileId != "forgiving") throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product profile does not bind the forgiving UNDERDRAIN challenge.");
            if (job.productId != profile.productId) throw new InvalidOperationException("Scene job binds a different player product.");
            if (job.playerProduct == null || !job.playerProduct.required || job.playerProduct.profileSha256 != Sha256File(GetRequiredArgument("-productProfile"))) throw new InvalidOperationException("Scene job lost exact player-product profile custody.");
            if (job.candidateAuthority != "Arc replay required") throw new InvalidOperationException("Scene job crossed candidate authority.");
            if (manifest.sourceActionSpecDigest != job.actionSpecDigest) throw new InvalidOperationException("Authored presentation targets a different action spec.");
            if (profile.presentationAdapterId != "production.prefab/v1" || profile.controlAdapterId != "natural.input/v1") throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product adapters are unsupported.");
            if (profile.presentation.primitiveFallbackAllowed || profile.presentation.diagnosticPresentationAllowed || profile.presentation.activeUnityPhysicsAuthorityAllowed) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product profile permits forbidden fallback, diagnostic, or physics authority.");
            if (!profile.productIdentity.serializedOnPlayerRoot || !profile.productIdentity.requiredAtRuntime || !profile.productIdentity.requiredForBuild || !profile.productIdentity.requiredForPhysicalSession) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product identity policy is incomplete.");
            if (!profile.acceptance.arcReplayRequired || profile.acceptance.candidateAuthority != "Arc replay required" || !profile.acceptance.roleSeparatedColdSeatsRequired || !profile.acceptance.coldPlayerObserverAdjudicatorMustDiffer || !profile.acceptance.coldPlayerObserverAdjudicatorLineagesMustDiffer || !profile.acceptance.coldPlayerObserverAdjudicatorContextsMustDiffer || !profile.acceptance.sourceIsolationRequired || !profile.acceptance.immutableObservationPacketRequired || profile.acceptance.runtimeMayIssueComprehensionReceipt || profile.acceptance.candidateAuthorMayIssueComprehensionReceipt || profile.acceptance.coldSeatReceiptMayClaimHumanEvidence || profile.acceptance.humanRequiredForWindowsSoftwareAcceptance || !profile.acceptance.physicalHumanEvidenceSeparate || !profile.acceptance.finalSoftwareAcceptorSeatMustDiffer || !profile.acceptance.finalSoftwareAcceptorLineageMustDiffer || !profile.acceptance.finalSoftwareAcceptorContextMustDiffer || profile.acceptance.finalAcceptorMayModifyArtifact || !profile.acceptance.namedPlayerProductAcceptanceRequired) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product acceptance policy is incomplete or permits self-certification.");
            if (!profile.presentation.namedRepresentationApprovalRequired || profile.presentation.representationApprovalReceiptFormat != "rodoh-action-production-asset-approval/2" || !profile.presentation.approvalMustBindCompleteDependencyClosure || !profile.presentation.approvalMustBindPrefabAndMetaCustody || !profile.presentation.approvalMustBindDeclaredBindingClosure || profile.presentation.minimumDeclaredBindingCount < 27 || profile.presentation.minimumUniqueDeclaredAssetCount < 23 || profile.presentation.representationIntakeReceiptFormat != "rodoh-action-production-asset-intake/3" || profile.presentation.representationAuditReceiptFormat != "rodoh-action-production-asset-audit/2" || !profile.presentation.readOnlyIntakeRequired || !profile.presentation.readOnlyPostSerializationAuditRequired || !profile.presentation.finalAcceptorMustDifferFromRepresentationApprover) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player-product profile lacks complete named representation-closure approval and audit policy.");
            if (worldCommit.Length != 40 || arcCommit.Length != 40) throw new InvalidOperationException("Exact source commits are absent.");
        }
